scope: Minimal input-contract and independent-reference input-domain corrections; synthetic correctness only
changes: Check root map before associative destructuring; reject key/value lists and bounded lazy poison without realization.
Require a nonempty assets vector containing only maps before reading any asset fields.
Accept exact standard immutable numeric classes only; reject DoubleAdder of both signs, AtomicLong, and custom Number implementations.
Convert each return once to a canonical double; validate finite normalized return >= -1 and retain raw exact lower-bound validation.
Default prepare-reference to :normalized-binary64 using prepared returns -> BigDecimal(double) -> rationalize.
Retain explicit :exact-input diagnostics with original-input rationalization, reject unknown modes with ExceptionInfo, and store :input-mode.
Move original-ratio and integral-exactness tests to explicit :exact-input; keep ordinary production comparisons on the default input domain.
Add strict regressions for large doubles, decimal cancellation, and large Long normalization, plus intended exact-mode differences.
Add :reference-input-mode to the verification summary only; do not change production evaluate arithmetic or share numerical reference logic.

red_green_evidence.additional_api_red_reason: Expected ArityException errors because the explicit two-argument mode API did not yet exist; numerical mismatch RED was separately demonstrated without errors.

limitations_and_observations: Exact-input mode is an original-rational/decimal diagnostic, not a production input-domain oracle; raw floating values use rationalize's decimal interpretation.

Same-domain mean conversions can differ slightly because the independent rational reference and direct DECIMAL128 finalization remain separate; verifier maximum mean error is recorded above, with zero risk error.
